risks.detection: monitor API changelogs + ingestion error rates
risks.rollback: pin old version or disable connector

risks.description: Rate limits throttle backfills and daily pulls; partial data leads to wrong conclusions.
risks.mitigation: paging, caching, incremental pulls, backfill windows

risks.description: Platform attribution double counts and biases (Meta/GA/email).
risks.detection: compare multi-touch vs platform-attributed vs Woo truth
risks.rollback: suppress recommendations when divergence exceeds threshold

risks.description: PII exposure via email/CRM exports or identity joins.
risks.mitigation: hash identifiers, minimize storage, strict scopes, encryption
risks.rollback: revoke tokens + purge datasets + incident response

risks.description: Email consent/suppression violations from wrong segmenting or exports.
risks.mitigation: audience approval class + suppression rules required for execution

risks.description: Accidental public posting / ad launches / budget changes.
risks.mitigation: L4 requires exact approved hash + scoped executor credentials
risks.rollback: delete/archive content; pause ads; restore budgets

risks.description: Timezone/currency mismatches distort daily metrics and ROAS.
